answer: Picture the agent economy as an ocean that new agents can only enter through a narrow inlet: each fresh identity must lock a refundable bond for ninety days before it can vote, earn attestations, or vouch for others. Honest agents get their deposit back, so the bridge into full participation costs them only patience. A sybil operator, however, must freeze capital for every fake account at once, and if peers catch the cluster colluding, every linked bond is slashed, turning a thousand puppets into a thousand losses.
